scope: posthoc read-only numerical diagnostics; no fitting, PCA changes, forwards or study reruns
historical_spectral_rule: lambda_min(Sigma) > 1e-10 * lambda_max(Sigma), no extra centering; whitening normalized Frobenius residual <=1e-8
posthoc_ill_conditioned_rule: full rank but s_min/s_max <=1e-8; flag only, no output changes
EVR_rule: NA unless full original training spectrum or reliable original total variance available
operator_rule: same float64 SVD rule; low rank does not invalidate prediction; exact full-space action requires invertibility
